Synopsis:
Switzerland posted 1.5% Q2 2026 GDP growth, its fastest in nearly five years, driven by a 10.5% surge in chemicals/pharma exports. The PMI hit 57.1 in August. However, Swiss inflation doubled in August on rising Middle East-driven fuel costs, raising the prospect of an SNB rate hike. Analysts expect growth to remain solid but moderate from Q2 levels, contingent on continued European — particularly German — recovery.
